description: Lists pending listings for one visible store. First resolve the store with hgr_list_channels, then call this tool using channelOAuthId from the selected store. For rankings, filtering and summaries, pass fields/sortBy/sortDirection/limit directly to this tool and answer from its response. Pending listing ids may be shown only where HGRWeb shows them. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

fields.description: Fields to return. Use projection for compact answers.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. HGRApi maximum is 10000.

showWeListForYou.description: Whether to include We List For You pending items.

sortBy.description: Field used to sort before limit/pagination.

name: hgr_get_pending_listings
title: Get Pending Listings
